notes: APPENDIX-ONLY static verification spec (Appendix E robustness '1treat', not a main-text unit of analysis; lead's ruling). Same rows as main-text spec T4_c2_luniq_song: areg luniq_song adoption_one _Iperiod*, abs(user_id) vce(cluster user_id) with adoption_one = adopter & weeks since adoption >= 0 (set_data '1treat' replaces adoption_mediumterm with adoption_one, tables.do 890-893). Main sample (tables.do get_data_mainsample, lines 58-66): period > 4, overlap_min <= period <= overlap_max (common observation window of the matched pair), matched == 1; 896 users = 448 adopters + 448 matched never-adopters (1:1 Mahalanobis matching on the logit propensity index, min_period and max_period; mahapick top-3 then mahaselectunique, seed 12345; 59 of 507 adopters left unmatched). Matched controls carry their partner's adoption week in adopt_period but their adoption dummies are always 0, so gvar g_adopt is NA (never treated) for them. data_provenance original: raw Last.fm CSVs shipped in the package (external/spotify_panel.csv, external/spotify_users.csv), rebuilt through the authors' importing_spotify_panel.do, matching.do and preclean.do (work copies with absolute paths; graphs, fitstat and coefplot commented out). Prepared file: mksc1051_mainsample.rds = preclean.dta restricted to the main sample plus g_adopt, adoption bins, adoption_one and the Table 8 rob_ outcomes.
